Alarmed by Israel's defeat of the Amorites, he summoned the diviner Balaam to pronounce a curse, only to hear blessings instead (Numbers 22-24). Later biblical writers recall his failed plot as a paradigm of God's sovereign protection of his people (Josh 24:9; Judg 11:25; Mic 6:5)."

  Sense 1: "Balak (personal name)"

All 43 occurrences cluster in Numbers 22-24 (the Balaam narrative), with retrospective mentions in Joshua 24:9, Judges 11:25, and Micah 6:5.
